positive_triggers: Inspect my existing course repository and relate its materials to my current learning goal.
Help me set up a named learning workspace and agree what belongs in Git.
I want to restructure my old learning repository so a future agent can resume where I left off.
negative_triggers: I have not decided what I want to learn; help me explore the goal first.
Update the progress journal from this lesson without changing the repository structure.

behavioral_evaluation.prompt: My existing learning repo has course notes, exercises, and some local changes. I want it to be easier to resume learning after a future clone. Inspect and suggest a structure, but do not move or edit files yet.
pass_criteria: Inspects the designated repository and preserves its existing local work.
Asks what learning state may be tracked and keeps private learner details out by default.
Asks whether restructuring is wanted, then proposes a current-to-target path map and explains reference or tooling effects.
Does not reorganize files or claim that repository artifacts prove understanding.
